segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Let's review the customer feedback from the last two weeks. We received forty two support tickets about the onboarding flow.

segments.speaker: Ava
segments.text: Most complaints are about the email verification step. Users say the verification email arrives late or lands in spam.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: That's a real problem for activation. What does the data say?

segments.speaker: Ava
segments.text: Activation dropped from sixty one percent to fifty four percent since the change, so the impact is significant.

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.text: On the positive side, customers love the new dashboard. The satisfaction score went up to four point six.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Excellent. We decided to move email verification to after the first project is created, so users can start right away.

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.text: I will update the onboarding designs by next Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Ava
segments.text: I will draft a customer email explaining the change by the end of the week.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Do we know whether enterprise customers need verification before inviting teammates?

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.text: Not sure, we need to check with the security team.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Ava, could you schedule a call with the security team by Monday?

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Thanks everyone, this was a productive session.
